svg.title: Neural network diagram
svg.desc: Convolutional neural network with 7 layers: Input (224×224×3), Conv 1 (conv 7×7, stride 2, 112×112×64), Pool (max 3×3, stride 2, 56×56×64), Conv 2 (conv 3×3, 56×56×128), Conv 3 (conv 3×3, stride 2, 28×28×256), Global pool (global avg, 256 values), Output (1000 values).
